name: Do I need to replace all my siding if only a section is rotted?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace all my siding if only a section is rotted?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, it's often not necessary to replace all your siding if only a specific section is rotted. A skilled general contractor can often perform a 'patch' repair, carefully removing and replacing only the damaged panels. The decision depends on the extent of the rot, the age and condition of the surrounding siding, and whether a seamless match can be achieved with new materials. An assessment will determine the most cost-effective and durable solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: You may not need to replace all siding; a patch repair is possible for localized rot. An assessment will determine the best solution.
